title: unified rollouts: proactive canary + shadow + A/B auto-rollback workflows
author: Avery Kumar
description: Motivation: provide an integrated workflow that composes proactive canary staging, shadow probing, and A/B experiment routing with automated rollback based on composite telemetry. This PR implements a new 'proactive' rollout workflow that runs a staged canary, simultaneously probes a shadow population with production-like requests, and supports parallel A/B traffic split routing; the autorollback engine evaluates composite metrics (latency p95, error-rate, quality-regression score) and triggers rollback or quarantine when thresholds are crossed. Design highlights: feature-flag guarded, safety-first defaults (conservative initial weights, probing quorum, quarantine stage), metric quorum to avoid noisy signals, and transparent observability hooks that emit per-stage telemetry for tracing and cost accounting. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs continue to work; new workflow is opt-in via rollout.strategy.type = "proactive" and can be enabled per-environment. Testing and validation: unit tests for controller and engine, integration tests with the rollout CRD, and an e2e harness that replays production request traces against canary/shadow paths. Rollout plan: staged rollout to canary namespace in dev, canary in staging with increased probe volume, and gradual enabling in production after 48h of metrics stability. Docs and examples: docs/rollouts.md and examples/proactive_workflow.yaml included. Checklist: - [x] implementation + unit tests - [x] e2e tests - [x] docs updated - [x] safety feature flag added - [x] monitoring dashboards updated
